trace.query: What haircut must male 2nd to 4th year college students follow?

graph_hits.label: Approximate evidence
graph_hits.frame:
APPROXIMATE MATCH (not an exhaustive result): Hairstyle/Haircut Policy
h:administeredBy -> Office of Student Affairs and Services (OSAS) [h:OSAS]
h:audience: New students
h:definition: Colored/tinted/dyed or out-of-the-ordinary styled hair, and funky short or fixie-crop hairstyles for male students, are prohibited unless minimal aesthetic coloring is approved by OSAS and the Campus Director. Male Freshmen/Senior High School students follow a 2x3 cut; 2nd-4th year college students follow a clean-cut/1x2 barber's cut, inspected monthly.
h:sourceArticle: Chapter 6, Article 4, Sec. 2
rdf:type -> Policy [h:Policy]
rdfs:label: Hairstyle/Haircut Policy

graph_hits.label: Approximate evidence
graph_hits.frame:
APPROXIMATE MATCH (not an exhaustive result): Clothing and Gender Representation Policy (LGBT/Gender Nonconforming Students)
h:administeredBy -> Office of Student Affairs and Services (OSAS) [h:OSAS]
h:definition: Transgender students have the right to dress and groom in accordance with their gender identity within the constraints of the adopted dress code. Transwomen wear the male uniform (pants/polo) with female-cut blouses of the same color; transmen wear pants/polo in the female uniform color. Grooming rules apply the same standard to male and female units; transgender girls are not required to have a male haircut or masculine clothing, and transgender boys are not required to maintain a female hairstyle, wear make-up, or feminine clothing.
h:sourceArticle: Chapter 6, Article 4, Sec. 6
rdf:type -> Policy [h:Policy]
rdfs:label: Clothing and Gender Representation Policy (LGBT/Gender Nonconforming Students)
